objective: Make corpus completion auditable and block finishing while known decisive candidates, high-signal files, or answer-cardinality defects remain unresolved.

changes.failure_pattern: Agents finished corpus set and ranking work despite surfaced but unread decisive files, discovered candidates missing from the register, affirmative comparator leakage, or unchecked post-draft reversals.
changes.mechanism: The stop tool now requires a typed completion audit and rejects corpus completion when reported unresolved candidates or unread high-signal files are nonzero, answer cardinality does not match, late changes are unchecked, or listed outputs are absent.
changes.rationale: C5 prompt and skill rules still permitted the same failures, so moving the final invariant into the stop tool provides a stronger deterministic intervention while retaining a capped rejection path.

changes.failure_pattern: The candidate ledger was manually assembled from selected results rather than reconciled losslessly to all high-signal discoveries, and internal ranking rows were later treated as publishable answers.
changes.mechanism: The skill adds an append-only discovery log, an explicit discovery-to-register set-difference invariant, zero-unresolved and zero-unread gates, precise singular-answer drafting rules, and an auditable amendment protocol for post-draft changes.
changes.rationale: The registered skill owns the detailed corpus procedure and can operationalize the finish fields while preserving C4-C5's supported population-boundary and evidence-sufficiency improvements.

changes.failure_pattern: The always-visible workflow did not require incremental lossless promotion of discoveries or make zero decisive gaps and singular output cardinality explicit before drafting and finishing.
changes.mechanism: The protocol routes every high-signal hit through a discovery log and register, forbids drafting with decisive unresolved work, limits singular outputs to the requested winner, and requires truthful completion-audit fields after final source checks.
changes.rationale: The prompt supplies concise routing and state transitions on every applicable task; the skill provides detail and the finish tool enforces the terminal state.
